midnight-harbor.$description: Midnight Harbor — Primary text, headings, logo, dark CTA banner — the near-black navy that carries the entire voice of the interface

signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Primary action background, logo wordmark, active nav and toggle states — the single bright chromatic accent against the navy/white axis

slate-channel.$description: Slate Channel — Secondary text, outlined link borders, muted icon strokes — mid-tone companion to Midnight Harbor for de-emphasized copy

pale-steel.$description: Pale Steel — Tertiary text and meta labels, light borders on headings — the lightest blue-gray still reading as chromatic

sea-fog.$description: Sea Fog — Card borders, image borders, link underlines, hairline dividers — the dominant neutral stroke color

ice-tint.$description: Ice Tint — Subtle background washes, hover surfaces, tinted input backgrounds — barely-there blue for grouping without weight

light-mist.$description: Light Mist — Disabled or secondary button fill, neutral surface accent — the warm-cool border between Ice Tint and Sea Fog

canvas-white.$description: Canvas White — Page background, card surface, button text — the dominant canvas that every other color sits on

active-teal.$description: Active Teal — Teal outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges

figtree.$description: Single-family system: weight 400 for body, 600 for emphasis, 700 for subheadings, 800 for display headlines. The heavy display weight is the signature — headlines feel stamped rather than set, a deliberate contrast to the quiet 400 body. Negative letter-spacing tightens proportionals as size grows.
